title: View the homepage hero and branding
description: A visitor can load the homepage and see the main hero content with campus branding.

steps.description: Verify the hero welcome content is displayed

title: Send a custom question to the help-desk chat
description: A visitor can type and send a custom admissions, fees, or courses question and see both the sent message and a bot response.

steps.description: Type a custom question into the chat message field
Verify the user message is displayed in the conversation
Verify a bot response is displayed

title: Jump to programs from the hero
description: A visitor can use the programs call to action to jump to the courses section and continue browsing the homepage.

steps.description: Click the explore programs call to action
Verify the courses section is displayed
Verify the homepage remains available after the jump

title: Use the sticky navigation to jump between sections
description: A visitor can use the persistent navigation to move to the main homepage sections from anywhere on the page.

steps.description: Verify the corresponding homepage sections are displayed

title: Read quick question replies in the chat drawer
description: A visitor can open the help-desk chat, use a suggested question chip, and see the bot reply.

steps.description: Verify the chat drawer is displayed
Verify the welcome message is displayed
Verify a bot reply is displayed

title: Scroll through the full homepage content
description: A visitor can scroll through the homepage and reach the main informational sections and footer.

steps.description: Verify the about section is displayed

title: Minimize and reopen the chat without losing the conversation
description: A visitor can minimize the chat drawer, reopen it, and continue with the existing conversation intact.

steps.description: Type a custom question into the chat message field
Verify the previous conversation is still displayed
Verify the chat drawer remains usable

title: Open and close the mobile navigation menu
description: A visitor on a small-screen layout can open the navigation menu, view section links, and close it again.

steps.description: Verify the section links are displayed in the navigation menu
Verify the navigation menu is hidden

title: Keep the homepage open when using the logo and auth buttons
description: A visitor can click the logo, login, and sign up controls without leaving the homepage or starting authentication.

steps.description: Verify the user remains on the homepage
Verify no authentication flow is started

title: Close the chat drawer and return to browsing
description: A visitor can close the help-desk chat drawer and continue using the homepage normally.

steps.description: Verify the chat drawer is hidden
Verify the homepage is still displayed

title: Stay on the homepage when opening navigation after chat use
description: A visitor can use chat and then return to section navigation without the page changing unexpectedly.

steps.description: Verify the courses section is displayed
Verify the homepage content remains accessible
